§6Uranium§f

§aThe most common radioactive element. Everything nuclear starts here.§f

Uranium is the foundation of nuclear technology in NTM. Most early nuclear science revolves around refining and breeding it.

Four forms: §bNatural Uranium§f (unenriched, mildly radioactive), §bU-238§f (non-fissile depleted uranium, byproduct of enrichment, used in weapons and armor for density), §bU-235§f (fissile, highly reactive, used in fuels and weapons), and §bUranium Fuel§f (U-238 + U-235 at 5:1 ratio).

Mining: found deep underground (y=5 to 25) in small pockets. §e7§f veins per chunk, §e5§f ore per vein. Mining releases radon gas, so wear a respirator.

Enrichment: §bGas Centrifuge§f for early-game, §bSILEX§f for late-game. Centrifuging ore also yields small amounts of §bRadium-226§f, useful as a neutron source.

§ePS:§f Don't skip the respirator. Radon exposure is not fun.
